last_episode_to_air.name: Ram Ends His Life
last_episode_to_air.overview: Guru Vashist, Hanuman, Luv and Kush are sad when Ram, Bharat and Shatrughan end their life. Later, Hanuman tears open his chest to show the residents of Ayodhya that Ram and Sita always reside in his heart.

name: Siya Ke Ram
overview: Traces the epic of Ramayan  which chronicles the journey of  Ram and Sita. Contrary to popular depictions of the Ramayana from Rama's perspective, this show will highlight Ramayan through Sita's eyes.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Janak is childless! His kingdom, Mithila has had a drought for 12 years. Elsewhere, Ram and his brothers are under the tutelage of Guru Vashisht. Janaka builds a golden sickle and unearths a baby girl, as he begins to plough! The baby's first cry leads to rainfall! Ram vows to reunite his mother with his sister. Sita questions her teacher Gautama Rishi and protects her father Rajrishi Janak.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Ram worships Lord Vishnu on his birthday and seeks blessings from his elders. Guru Vashisht blesses him to guide mankind. Kaikeyi and Ram strengthen their bond. Ram wants to mingle with the people of Ayodhya. Mareech and Subahu torture and imprison rishis on their way to sage Vishwamitra's ashram.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Subahu secretly watches Mareech perform the last rites of Tadaka. Later, he tries to kill Mareech for seeking Ram's forgiveness. Sita is in love with Ram and daydreams about him. Janak conveys his intention to Sita about her marriage. The demons attack Vishwamitra's ashram again. Sita will be married off to the person who will fulfill the condition to string the  Shiva's bow. No one seems to be able to lift Shiva's bow. Will Ram and Sita get married?

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Uncertain about her future, Manthara begins planning a diabolical list. Raja Dashrath remembers his curse and falls ill.  Ram takes over the royal duties during his illness. After Raja Dashrath's recovery, he decides to resign his duties as king and crown Ram as king. But then Manthara's trick takes effect and Ram is banished to the forest for 14 years.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Raja Dashrath cannot bear the distance to Ram and dies. Bharat never wanted the throne and abdicates the throne. Both Shatrughan and Bharat punish Kaikeyi and Manthara. Bharat tries to bring back Ram from exile. Will he succeed?

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Sita is abducted by the evil Ravan. With the help of Hanuman, Ram forms an alliance with Sugriva. After a long search, they find the whereabouts of Sita. Sugriva's army makes a bridge to Lanka and the war between Ram's army and Ravan begins in order to bring back Sita.
